record.reason: The study extends recurrent-model inference beyond nominal step budgets and measures exact-solve completion on hard Sudoku, with latent-state stability analysis. It shows additional computation can rescue some nominal-budget failures, but does not propose an efficiency improvement or general LLM serving method; the benchmark is narrow and model-specific.
record.title: When Recursive Models Finish Computing
